subject: Staged close playbook: signature deadline & MAP owners (draft)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hsu <emily.hsu@maplehealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@maplehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged close playbook: signature deadline & MAP owners (draft)

Hi Emily / Tom —

Great to meet yesterday — appreciate the time. Per our discovery, attached is a very small draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP_draft_v1.pdf) and a light SOW outline (SOW_outline_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones, suggested owners, and dependencies. High-level asks and proposed dates below so we can align procurement/contract timing with your fiscal close windows.

Quick summary (proposed):
- Target close (commercial go-live): 2027-05-14
- Contract signature deadline for procurement/legal: 2027-05-10 (allows ops to schedule onboarding week of 5/17)
- Key milestones:
  * PO/Intention to proceed (Maple) — 2027-04-30 — owner: Emily Hsu (procurement)
  * Legal redline completed — 2027-05-03 — owner: Tom Alvarez (legal)
  * Contract signature — 2027-05-10 — owner: Maple Health / Redwood legal
  * Onboarding kickoff / capacity allocation — 2027-05-17 — owner: Redwood onboarding (Laura)

Dependencies we flagged: procurement internal approvals; legal review window; any SOC/infosec checklist items (we heard 3rd party questionnaire required). If procurement needs a longer runway, we can do a staggered approach: PO + interim MSA terms to secure capacity, followed by final signature.

Next steps I’m proposing:
1) Emily / Tom: confirm whether 5/10 signature is feasible or advise the latest acceptable signature date for your fiscal close planning.
2) If 5/10 is tight, indicate which milestone(s) need to shift and whether a PO-first approach would be acceptable.
3) Internal: Karthik and Laura — please review the attached SOW and flag anything that would impact the onboarding start date.

Attaching MAP_draft_v1.pdf and SOW_outline_v1.xlsx for your review. I’ll consolidate feedback and send a revised MAP.

Thanks —

Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (map, milestones), SOW_outline_v1.xlsx (ops dependencies)

From: Emily Hsu <emily.hsu@maplehealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@maplehealth.com>, procurement@maplehealth.com
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged close playbook: signature deadline & MAP owners (draft)

Sean —

Thanks for the summary and the drafts. A few items from our side after an initial skim:

- Procurement window: our fiscal close is end of May, but procurement needs signed paperwork no later than 2027-05-20 to get budgeted into May month-end. 5/10 would be excellent but optimistic for us — legal will likely need a formal redline cycle.
- Legal queue: Tom here — I can prioritize a first read if we can lock a follow-up by 2027-04-28 for an initial redline. If your team can accept an initial PO/intent to proceed and then final signature by 5/20, that may be the most realistic path.
- SOC/questionnaire: procurement flagged the infosec questionnaire — we’ll send the form to your security contact next week.

Actionable ask from us: can Redwood provide a two-stage option in the MAP: (A) PO / onboarding hold (non-binding) to secure capacity; (B) final MSA signature by 2027-05-20? If so, include acceptance criteria for the PO stage so Finance is comfortable.

I’ll coordinate with procurement and get back with confirmed latest acceptable signature date by Monday.

Best,
Emily Hsu
Head of Procurement | Maple Health
emily.hsu@maplehealth.com

On Fri, Apr 17, 2027 at 09:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> [original message attached]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emily Hsu <emily.hsu@maplehealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@maplehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged close playbook: signature deadline & MAP owners (draft)

Thanks Emily — and Tom, appreciate the availability. I went through the MAP and SOW outline and attached a light update (SOW_outline_v1_karthik_comments.xlsx) and an annotated MAP suggestion inline. My proposals to support a two-stage close:

1) PO-first hold (target by 2027-04-30)
   - Purpose: reserve dedicated GPU pool and onboarding slot.
   - Redwood deliverable on PO: capacity reservation confirmation + intake forms completed by 2027-05-07.
   - Maple deliverable on PO: signed PO or written intent that triggers finance earmark. Owner: Emily

2) Legal redline cadence
   - Redwood commits to turn-around on redlines within 48 business hours for first two rounds to accelerate review. Owner: Redwood legal (Marissa).
   - Target window: 2027-04-28 initial redline, 2027-05-03 final signoff performed by both sides. If Maple needs extra cycles, we push final signature to 2027-05-20 as a fallback.

3) Onboarding kickoff remains 2027-05-17 assuming PO/reservation is in place. If signature finalizes after 5/17, onboarding will proceed under a limited-scope kickoff for non-production testing (we’ll note this in the MAP). Owner: Laura (Redwood onboarding).

We can add a clause: "Contract signature by 2027-05-20 will not retroactively affect capacity reservation if PO was received by 2027-04-30." That tends to ease procurement concerns about resource allocation.

Emily — if you can confirm whether the PO-first approach is acceptable, we’ll convert the attached suggestions into MAP_draft_v2 and circulate.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_outline_v1_karthik_comments.xlsx (ops notes), MAP_draft_v2_notes.txt

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@maplehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Hsu <emily.hsu@maplehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staged close playbook: signature deadline & MAP owners (draft)

Karthik / Sean —

We can do the PO-first approach. Internal legal can slot an initial read on 2027-04-28 (as noted) and we can aim for final signature no later than 2027-05-18 to align approvals. That gives procurement the budget entry and allows a short legal touch after your rapid redline turnarounds.

Please update the MAP to include:
- PO receipt by 2027-04-30 triggers capacity hold.
- Target final signature 2027-05-18 (Maple target, may slip to 5/20 in exceptional cases).
- Clear acceptance criteria for PO-stage (what Redwood must deliver to hold capacity).

I’ll have procurement confirm budget coding once Emily completes the internal sign-off.

Tom Alvarez
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Maple Health
Tom.Alvarez@maplehealth.com
